edits.after: Sometimes, assessing the nature of the quiet requires asking during a calm period rather than at the moment of a trigger. Immediately after an argument stops, asking “Have we actually resolved it?” may ignite it again. When both people are steadier, a narrow question can establish the arrangement: “If the same kind of expense arises next month, what will we do?” The answer is easier to test than demanding reassurance that the other person has really let it go.
edits.reason: Repairs demanding someone declare a question; retains timing, specific expense example and observable arrangement versus inner-assent demand.
edits.before: Sometimes, assessing the nature of the quiet requires asking during a calm period rather than at the moment of a trigger. Immediately after an argument stops, asking “Have we actually resolved it?” may ignite it again. When both people are steadier, a narrow question can establish the arrangement: “If the same kind of expense arises next month, what will we do?” The answer is easier to test than a demand that the other person declare, “Have you really let it go?”

edits.after: Es un punto de parada real.
edits.reason: Detención can mean arrest; source means genuine stopping point for recurring conflict.

edits.after: Los abuelos consideran que cuidar no debería ser seguir una tabla de horarios al pie de la letra y que el niño puede tener más flexibilidad en entornos distintos.
edits.reason: Naturalizes ejecutar una tabla while preserving fixed schedule versus flexible care contrast.
edits.before: Los abuelos consideran que cuidar no debería parecerse a ejecutar una tabla y que el niño puede tener más flexibilidad en entornos distintos.

edits.after: They cannot order someone to feel that the relationship is back to what it was.
edits.reason: Naturalizes order someone inwardly to restore relationship, retaining limit of institutional authority over inner relationship.
edits.before: It cannot order someone inwardly to restore the relationship to what it was.

edits.after: No pueden ordenar a nadie que vuelva a sentir la relación como antes.
edits.reason: Naturalizes ordering someone's interior to restore relationship, preserving public authority versus inner judgment distinction.
edits.before: No ordenar que el interior de alguien devuelva la relación a su estado anterior.

edits.after: Probaron a explicarse, a buscar soluciones de compromiso y a repartir de nuevo las funciones.
edits.reason: Compromises are negotiated concessions, not bare compromisos understood as promises; retains all three attempted methods.
edits.before: Probaron explicaciones, compromisos y un nuevo reparto de funciones.

edits.after: They have a right to tell the story of their own experiences.
edits.reason: Idiomatic tell the story of experiences rather than tell experiences; scope remains first-person testimony.
edits.before: They have a right to tell their own experiences.

edits.after: From here on, their life beyond the story we shared is not mine to write.
edits.reason: Preserves closing boundary around what is mine to narrate, avoiding a literal implication that parts of another person once belonged to me.
edits.before: From this point onward, the part of this person that no longer belongs to me is not mine to write.

edits.after: De aquí en adelante, no me corresponde escribir su vida más allá de la historia que compartimos.
edits.reason: Preserves story/author boundary in natural Spanish rather than implying ownership over a part of the other person.
edits.before: Lo que de esta persona ya no me pertenece, a partir de aquí no lo escribo yo.
